public.suggestedRevision: Insert first WHO tools bullet; place A24.02 immediately after it: • WHO ICD API and local deployments — WHO services exposing ICD-11 Foundation and MMS content, identifiers, releases, search, and coding-related information. The API can be accessed through WHO-hosted services or suitable local deployments, including operation without a continuous external connection. It provides a concrete implementation route for an ICD-11-based semantic service. Implementers should declare the supported content, release, language, and operations. The separately documented WHO FHIR interface is under active development; implementations relying on it should declare its FHIR version, release coverage, publication status and tested operations at the time of implementation.
